info.title: XPS Ship Universal API
info.description: XPS Ship is an eCommerce shipping API for retrieving services and quotes, managing eCommerce orders, retrieving shipment and label data, searching shipments, and managing order tags.

put.description: Assigns tags to an order in XPS Ship.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

integrationId.description: XPS Ship REST API integration ID.

tagIds.description: Array of tag IDs to assign to the order.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a shipping quote in XPS Ship.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

weightUnit.description: Weight unit: lb, oz, kg, or g.

dimUnit.description: Dimension unit: in, cm, or null when package type has preset dimensions.

currency.description: Currency for insurance, declared value, and customs value.

pieces.description: Shipment pieces with weight, dimensions, insurance amount, and declared value.

carrierCode.description: Optional carrier code to limit the quote request.

serviceCode.description: Optional service code for quoting a specific service.

packageTypeCode.description: Optional package type code for quoting a specific package type.

residential.description: Set true when the destination address is residential.

signatureOptionCode.description: Optional signature option code for the shipment.

contentDescription.description: Optional shipment content description, often needed for international shipments.

billingParty.description: Optional billing party: sender, receiver, or third_party.

providerAccountId.description: Optional provider account ID for the quote request.

packageTypeCode.description: Package type code for the quote.

pieces.description: USPS multipiece quote details, when returned.

quotes.description: Multiple quote results when no specific service or package type is specified.

serviceDescription.description: Service description, returned when quoting multiple services.

zone.description: Zone used to compute the quote.

put.description: Creates or updates an order in XPS Ship.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

integrationId.description: XPS Ship REST API integration ID.

orderId.description: Unique order ID, matching the orderId in the request body.

bodyOrderId.description: Required order ID in the JSON body; must match the URL order ID.

orderNumber.description: Invoice number of the order, or null.

fulfillmentStatus.description: One of pending, fulfilled, or partial.

shippingService.description: Name of shipping service associated with order, or null.

shippingTotal.description: Amount the customer paid for shipping, or null.

weightUnit.description: Weight unit, lb or kg, or null.

dimUnit.description: Dimension unit, in or cm, or null.

dueByDate.description: Date by which the order must be fulfilled, or null.

orderGroup.description: Group for multi-user shipping, or null.

shipperReference.description: Optional reference text to show on the shipping label.

shipperReference2.description: Optional second reference field for the label when supported by the carrier.

contentDescription.description: Optional content description of the shipment.

ok.description: True when the order was created or updated.
